step.label: Initiate Engineering Change Request
step.description: Engineering team submits a change request to modify product design, materials, or manufacturing processes.
step.useCase: Product redesign or material substitution triggered by quality, cost, or compliance needs

step.label: Validate Material and Compliance Requirements
step.description: System verifies that proposed materials meet safety standards, environmental regulations, and vendor compliance obligations.
step.useCase: Ensure material changes do not violate EHS, regulatory, or supplier quality standards

step.label: Check Production Workforce Readiness
step.description: Confirm that manufacturing team has required skills and production capacity to support the engineering change without disruption.
step.useCase: Validate workforce capability and production schedule alignment before material switchover

step.label: Manage Employee Access and Approvals
step.description: Orchestrate role-based access provisioning and approval workflows for engineers and procurement staff involved in the change.
step.useCase: Ensure appropriate personnel have system access to approve and execute the engineering change

step.label: Retrieve Master Material and Vendor Data
step.description: Query current material specifications, alternate suppliers, and vendor performance metrics to support procurement planning.
step.useCase: Identify qualified vendors and material alternatives for the approved engineering change

step.label: Evaluate Supplier Qualification and Service Capability
step.description: Assess candidate suppliers' technical qualification, service level agreements, and ability to support the new material or process change.
step.useCase: Confirm that selected vendors can meet delivery, quality, and support requirements for the change

step.label: Create and Manage Purchase Orders
step.description: Generate purchase orders with vendors for new materials, coordinate delivery schedules, and track procurement status.
step.useCase: Procure materials from qualified vendors while tracking cost, delivery, and quality metrics

step.label: Monitor Employee Time-Off and Staffing Continuity
step.description: Track planned absences and time-off balance to ensure sufficient staffing during material transition and production ramp-up.
step.useCase: Prevent production disruptions by ensuring adequate workforce availability during engineering change implementation
